seoDesc: Looking for a removal company in Uccle? Trust our specialist company for safe transport of your belongings.
h1: Moving in Uccle with a local team

intro.p: Moving to Uccle? Make the right choice from the start! We are close by, we answer quickly and we adapt the service to your move.

body.p: Moving is not always an easy step. Paperwork, packing, transport, mental preparation… All of this takes some organisation. Gérard & Fils is here to support you at every stage of your move in Uccle.

sections.h: 1. A local team that knows Uccle inside out

body.p: Active in Uccle and the surrounding area for many years, we respond quickly in every neighbourhood: Calevoet, Parvis, Saint‑Job… Our team knows the access routes, parking permits and local specifics perfectly. No more logistical headaches!

sections.h: 2. Flexible plans, from small moves to a full service

body.p: Whether you only want help transporting your belongings or prefer a more complete service including packing and dismantling your furniture, we offer different removal plans to best meet your needs. Depending on the volume of your belongings, we estimate the number of removers required so the job gets done efficiently without unnecessary extra cost.
Each plan can be supplemented with practical options: furniture lift hire, protective materials or furniture storage.

sections.h: 3. A transparent quote and clear pricing

body.p: Say goodbye to surprises: your quote is personalised, with no hidden costs. We also advise you on related formalities such as booking a temporary parking space in Uccle.

sections.h: 4. Care and safety for your belongings

body.p: Our removers are trained to handle fragile items (crockery, mirrors, antique furniture) using professional packaging and suitable techniques. In the event of the unexpected, your belongings are covered by liability insurance.

sections.h: Why move with us in Uccle?

body.p: Choosing us for your move means enjoying:

ul: Local presence: a team based in the Brussels region, responsive and available
Total flexibility: from simple transport to a turnkey package
Suitable equipment: boxes, covers, lift… everything is provided!
Administrative support: advice on the various permits, parking and formalities with the municipality
Insurance included, and one team that follows your move

sections.h: Need a hand, a quote or some advice?

body.p: Entrust us with your move within Brussels and all its municipalities, whether it is Rhode-Saint-Genèse, Etterbeek, Ixelles, Jette, Watermael-Boitsfort, Woluwe, Auderghem or Forest. We offer complete services, from packing your belongings in boxes to reassembling your furniture, with excellent value for money. Tables, desks, crockery, bookcases… every item is handled with the greatest care by our team of professionals. With Gérard & Fils, you benefit from secure transport and flawless handling, throughout the Brussels region and beyond. Take advantage of the quality of our services for your move!
